name: page-header
summary: Introduces a page with one H1, supporting description, and admitted app-owned actions.

agent.useWhen: A page needs its primary H1, optional supporting context, and a responsive actions slot.
agent.avoidWhen: A nested card, dialog, or section needs a local heading rather than the page's H1.

invariants: The title is always rendered as the page's H1; a nonblank description is optional supporting text.
Title and description are plain text, HTML-escaped, nonblank when supplied, and contain no control characters.
Title and description are text inputs. The optional actions child slot takes app-authored markup admitted by the host, never a data-bound or deserialized raw-HTML property.
The static header owns no IDs, events, commands, routes, client state, or JavaScript lifecycle.
The adapter fragment contains exactly one [[page-header]] slot; the renderer expands it as a single-pass substitution.
